'''Brandon Pahl''' (Players Committee forum handle '''Mr. blp''')<ref name="pcf-3824-52320">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52320#52320 Toronto, Ontario - August 22nd], Brandon Pahl, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905213115/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52320%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> is a Star Wars CCG player. He organized Star Wars CCG tournaments at 401 Convenience, 401 Yonge Street, Toronto: on 22 August 2004, the first of a series of tournaments after the release of [[Virtual Set 7]] planned to run until the New Year,<ref name="pcf-3824-52320" /> and on 7 November 2004, both six-game constructed events with a $10 entry fee and mandatory decklists.<ref name="pcf-4035-54965">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54965#54965 Toronto Star Wars Tourney!! Nov. 7], Brandon Pahl, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041104184026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55278%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
